# Diffdump

> Diffdump is a no-account web service for reviewing GitHub pull requests, commits, and comparisons in a clean, focused viewer, and for turning raw unified Git diffs into unlisted, expiring share links.

Canonical origin: https://diffdump.com

Diffdump renders multi-file patches with syntax highlighting, unified and split layouts, line wrapping, a searchable file tree, file categories, and light and dark themes.

Public GitHub pull requests, commits, and comparisons can be opened directly without creating or storing anything. Replace `github.com` with `diffdump.com` in a supported GitHub URL, or paste the URL into the form on the home page.

Example:

```text
https://github.com/org/repo/pull/123
https://diffdump.com/org/repo/pull/123
```

Private GitHub repositories can be viewed with an optional classic personal access token carrying `repo` scope. GitHub reviews are client-only: the browser fetches the diff straight from `api.github.com` and renders it locally. The token stays in browser local storage, and neither the token nor the fetched diff is submitted to or stored by Diffdump.

Raw unified diffs can instead be shared as unlisted review links. To create a share programmatically, send a `PUT` request to `https://diffdump.com/d` with a raw UTF-8 unified diff as the request body. A successful request returns `201 Created` with the unlisted review URL as `text/plain`. Empty or invalid diffs return `400`, diffs larger than 2 MiB return `413`, rate-limited requests return `429` with a `Retry-After` header, and storage failures return `500`.

Example:

```sh
git diff | curl -T- https://diffdump.com/d
```

Terminal clients may add `X-Diffdump-GitHub-Repo: owner/repository` and `X-Diffdump-Base-Sha: <full 40-character SHA>` headers. Shares with both headers can expand collapsed context on demand. Generate the patch with `git -c core.quotepath=off diff --full-index --binary <base-sha>` so non-ASCII file paths stay literal and remain expandable. The viewer fetches the base file directly from GitHub and applies the uploaded patch locally; public repositories work anonymously, while private repositories use an optional GitHub token stored only in the viewer's browser.

Shared diffs use random 96-bit URL slugs, are stored in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket, expire after 24 hours, and are marked `noindex, nofollow`. Share URLs are unlisted rather than access-controlled; anyone possessing a URL can open it. There is no public listing.

## Primary resources

- [Diffdump](https://diffdump.com/): Review a GitHub diff or create an unlisted diff share.
- [GitHub diff viewer](https://diffdump.com/github-diff-viewer): Open a public or private GitHub pull request, commit, or comparison.
- [Share a Git diff](https://diffdump.com/share-git-diff): Turn a raw unified diff into an unlisted 24-hour review link.
- [CLI workflow](https://diffdump.com/docs/cli): Pipe working-tree, staged, or committed changes to a review URL.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/hsyntax/diffdump): Source code, complete capabilities, architecture, local development, and deployment instructions.

## Optional

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): Format used by this file.
